doc.brief: Asynchronous API to present a print dialog to the user.
doc.md:
Asynchronous API to present a print dialog to the user.

`GtkPrintDialog` collects the arguments that are needed to present
 the dialog, such as a title for the dialog and whether it should
 be modal.

The dialog is shown with the [`PrintDialog.setup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:setup) function.

The actual printing can be done with [`PrintDialog.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print) or
[`PrintDialog.print_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print_file). These APIs follows the GIO async pattern,
and the results can be obtained by calling the corresponding finish methods.

print.brief: This function prints content from a stream.
print.md:
This function prints content from a stream.

If you pass `NULL` as `setup`, then this method will present a print dialog.
Otherwise, it will attempt to print directly, without user interaction.

The `callback` will be called when the printing is done.

print_file.md:
This function prints a file.

If you pass `NULL` as `setup`, then this method will present a print dialog.
Otherwise, it will attempt to print directly, without user interaction.

print_file_finish.brief: Finishes the [`PrintDialog.print_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print_file) call and returns the results.
print_file_finish.md:
Finishes the [`PrintDialog.print_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print_file) call and
returns the results.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

print_finish.brief: Finishes the [`PrintDialog.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print) call and returns the results.
print_finish.md:
Finishes the [`PrintDialog.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print) call and
returns the results.

If the call was successful, the content to be printed should be
written to the returned output stream. Otherwise, `NULL` is returned.

The overall results of the print operation will be returned in the
[`OutputStream.close()`](xref:gtk:Gio.OutputStream#method:close) call, so if you are interested in the
results, you need to explicitly close the output stream (it will be
closed automatically if you just unref it). Be aware that the close
call may not be instant as it operation will for the printer to finish
printing.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

setup.brief: This function presents a print dialog to let the user select a printer, and set up print settings and page setup.
setup.md:
This function presents a print dialog to let the user select a printer,
and set up print settings and page setup.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is dismissed.
The obtained [`PrintSetup`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintSetup) can then be passed
to [`PrintDialog.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print) or [`PrintDialog.print_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print_file).

One possible use for this method is to have the user select a printer,
then show a page setup UI in the application (e.g. to arrange images
on a page), then call [`PrintDialog.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:print) on `self`
to do the printing without further user interaction.

setup_finish.md:
Finishes the [`PrintDialog.setup()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintDialog#method:setup) call.

If the call was successful, it returns a [`PrintSetup`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintSetup)
which contains the print settings and page setup information that
will be used to print.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.
